report_name: Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool was used to inform the development of a draft list of proposed interventions and to identify routes that promote health and economic gains, such as from residential areas to the city centre and to key employment areas.
other_tools_developed: An appraisal framework scoring schemes from 1-5 across four criteria: Effectiveness, Policy, Economic, and Deliverability.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The Propensity to Cycle Tool was used to identify and prioritize specific routes for improvement, such as residential to city center connections and commuting routes to major employment sites like the Nissan plant and Doxford International.
pct_usage_quote: We have used the Department for Transport’s Propensity to Cycle Tool to inform the development of a draft list of proposed interventions. This has allowed us to identify routes that will promote health and economic gains.
